# Principles profile

Authority: Theme 16 accepted. Used by skill **`author-standards`** (mode `principles`).  
**Host-owned** — copy to e.g. `docs/standards/principles.md` (path override OK).  
**Altitude:** philosophy / tone / continuity — **not** checkable lint rules (those belong in a standards profile).
